property_summary: The contract always returns true after processing transfers; the buggy version returns false, violating the invariant that the return value must be true when the function does not revert.

For any admissible inputs (non-empty _tos with matching v length), the function transfer must return true when it completes without reverting; the buggy version always returns false, violating this invariant.
For any admissible input where _tokens.length == v.length and caddress is a contract that successfully handles the call, C.transfer returns true; the mutant returns false, violating the invariant.
